officialSummary: CCI approves acquisition of three professional cricket franchises: Rajasthan Royals (India), Paarl Royals (South Africa) and Barbados Royals (Barbados) by Westview Cricket Ltd. and Poonawalla Sports and Fitness Pvt Ltd
title: CCI approves acquisition of three professional cricket franchises: Rajasthan Royals (India), Paarl Royals (South Africa) and Barbados Royals (Barbados) by Westview Cricket Ltd. and Poonawalla Sports and Fitness Pvt Ltd
